clusters.pick_reason: #2215 factors the fix into a single shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper instead of duplicating the same regex inline in two places (buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls, as #2214 does), and it also updates shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` to match the new normalized-empty-string convention. #2214 (labeled chore) does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, so merging it alone risks leaving the root-detection check out of sync with the new normalization output, causing redundant fallback discovery requests at the root path — exactly the regression #2215's title and fix target.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both patch the same buggy trailing-slash-stripping line in buildWellKnownPath() (the original `if (pathname.endsWith('/')) pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1)` only strips one slash, leaving malformed paths like `/foo//.well-known/...` when a URL has multiple trailing slashes), replacing it with a full `replace(/\/+$/, '')` strip.
